changelog:
CSM settings search now ranks real title matches first: exact title, then title prefix, then title text, then descriptions, with internal keys last.
Search results keep the owning area heading attached to its rows, so a jump from search still shows where the setting lives.
Browsing order, native ownership, callbacks and the existing duplicate-suppression rules are unchanged when no query is active.
message: Dev build v853 - Default full list, tile grid and jump navigation
